limitations: Four-page NBS history is an institutional retrospective, not the underlying laboratory report.
No claim about legal compliance or present condition of any existing bridge.
The 1971 inspection interval and 2022 terminology are expressly dated.
No numerical crack dimension is used because inspected public summaries describe different dimensions and levels of rounding.
No causal percentages or quantitative risk estimates are supplied.
